# Painting chrome license plate housings to match body color

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Paint chrome housings to match body color after replacing bulbs and wiring. [t267]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Lower the spare tire down.
2. Push the spare tire forward out of the way without disconnecting its chain.
3. Remove the old housings by pulling or pushing their U-shaped internal clips to release them from the bumper.
4. [Partial] Twist and pull each light housing outward to remove it, leaving two holes in the bumper and two loose bulb connectors behind.
5. [Partial] Cut off the corroded ends of the existing bulb wire harnesses if necessary.
6. Splice new connector pieces onto the cut wires using crimping tools.
7. Apply heat shrink tubing over each splice connection to create a watertight seal.
8. Slide wire sheathing over the protected connections to prevent future rubbing damage.
9. Squeeze dielectric grease into one of the bulb connectors.
10. Insert an LED light bulb into the greased connector and place it inside its housing.
11. [Partial] Turn on the truck's lights to verify illumination, rotating the bulb 180 degrees if needed before reinserting it.
12. Confirm both bulbs work correctly after any rotation adjustments.
13. Slide each new mounting clip under the bumper from below to secure a housing in place.
14. Push the corresponding wire connector into the back of that housing and twist until locked.
15. Repeat the clipping and connecting process for the second side.

_Procedure reported by [t267]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-replace-license-plate-light-housings-on-05-08-xterra.8848/>_
